items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I studied with Billy Gladstone, he was at Radio City Music Hall... I studied with him a couple of years.

ctx.x: Okay, so you were getting your technical thing together at that point.

Then, at that point. See, he was my first teacher. Of course from then on, there on, oh goodness, I've had any number of teachers, you know. I studied with Billy Gladstone, he was at Radio City Music Hall.
